title: 3 hour private Kiteboarding Lesson in Miami
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us in this incredible experience! Best conditions to learn this awesome sport!
The experience begins from the moment you get on the boat, a nice ride from the Marina to our Spot on Biscayne Bay. By the time boat is arriving at the sandbar you’ll see the most beautiful, clear and shallow water.

You will be assisted by our professional team and our IKO certified instructors. (International Kiteboarding Organization).We operate on a privileged spot in Biscayne National Park: a sandbar with it’s a big flat and shallow water, perfect conditions for learning.

You will enjoy the experience on the boat, lessons and a ride on one of the greatest spots in South Florida to practice this sport, with the best qualified crew taking care of you.
